steps.text:
I couldn't create the invoice. PayPal rejected the request with **HTTP 401, "Token signature verification failed"** (code `PAYPAL_API_HTTP_ERROR`).

- **What I sent:** `paypal/create_invoice` with currency USD, recipient client@example.com, and one line item "Consulting - October" (quantity 1, $250.00).
- **Why it failed:** The gateway's policy allowed the call, so it wasn't a permissions block. PayPal refused the credentials. The PayPal connection is configured with a placeholder access token (`PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN=dummy`) in the sandbox environment, so any PayPal call will fail the same way.
- **Result:** No invoice was created, so there's no invoice ID.

**Next step:** Someone with access to the PayPal integration needs to set up a valid access token, and a production one if this should be a real invoice. After that I can run the same request again. You could also give me any details you want added, such as a due date, invoice number, your business name or a note.

final_text:
I couldn't create the invoice. PayPal rejected the request with **HTTP 401, "Token signature verification failed"** (code `PAYPAL_API_HTTP_ERROR`).

- **What I sent:** `paypal/create_invoice` with currency USD, recipient client@example.com, and one line item "Consulting - October" (quantity 1, $250.00).
- **Why it failed:** The gateway's policy allowed the call, so it wasn't a permissions block. PayPal refused the credentials. The PayPal connection is configured with a placeholder access token (`PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN=dummy`) in the sandbox environment, so any PayPal call will fail the same way.
- **Result:** No invoice was created, so there's no invoice ID.

**Next step:** Someone with access to the PayPal integration needs to set up a valid access token, and a production one if this should be a real invoice. After that I can run the same request again. You could also give me any details you want added, such as a due date, invoice number, your business name or a note.
